remarks: Introducing 21 Locust Ave, New Canaan – an exceptional commercial building. This owner-occupied building is well maintained offering a professional environment for your business. A welcoming lobby with an elevator provides convenient access for you and your clients visiting.  Home to quiet, respectable tenants and local business headquarters, this building offers a serene working atmosphere. The exterior of this charming brick building complements the famed New Canaan red brick sidewalk. Situated next to the beloved Joe's Pizza and just steps from Forest Street, you'll have easy access to a variety of dining options. The building's walkable location ensures convenience to all that the town has to offer. Limited parking is available for select suites, while the Locust Street lot across the street provides ample and generous parking opportunities. As a New Canaan business, you can also benefit from free annual passes for for this lot. Don't miss this exceptional opportunity to position your business in the heart of New Canaan's thriving downtown.  Suite 2-B-4-7 is located on the 2nd floor and faces Locust Avenue with large windows. Suite is made up of three offices and a center space with flexible fourth office, reception or storage. Please see floor plan and photos. Enjoy picturesque views of Locust Ave, showcasing the new Post Office building. Plenty of natural light floods each office, creating an inviting and productive workspace. Tenant pays rent no extra CAM.
